statement: For the actual integral special outer S3-lattices T_n over Z_p, p=2,3 and1<=n<=9, H1(S3,T_n)=0. Positive integral cohomology is killed by p, and H2(S3,T_n) is canonically identified with modular H1(S3,T_n/p), giving dimensions(0,0,1,0,1,0,2,0,3) at2 and(0,0,0,0,0,0,0,1,0) at3.
manuscript_passages: Section52.3–4; folios748–758; scans201–221 (cote140-4); explicit exceptional-prime and cohomology follow-up in prompt Part B, after LM2(3)
notes: The exact coefficient sequences distinguish integral and modular H1. Saved d0 ranks were independently checked against the two generator matrices; rational invariant ranks were independently recomputed by the character formula. The equivariant identification T_n=ker(V tensor L_n->L_{n+1}) and all generator conventions are explicit. No all-degree conclusion follows from this finite computation alone.
